first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence supports shortening onboarding and simplifying signup. A small guarded test targets the current funnel problem while limiting risk to qualified revenue and avoiding broad promotional pricing, which previously harmed retention.

final.rationale: Run a segmented standard experiment shortening onboarding, prioritizing self-serve accounts where completion and activation are currently declining. The verified shortened flow improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention. Signup simplification also improved SMB activation and qualified revenue, but its slight retention decline and limited segment evidence require guardrails. Measure activation, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention before rollout.
